SYMPTOM: Vinted doesn't expose a public API
FIX: Server-side fetch session cookie from vinted.lt homepage on first request, cache it, route all search queries through Next.js API routes as a proxy
GOTCHA: Cookie may expire and need refresh — build cache invalidation
MARKET: vinted.lt is the default (Lithuania). Other options: vinted.fr, vinted.de
WHY SERVER-SIDE: Avoids CORS and hides the scraping mechanism from client
